eligible_plans: Exact locally reviewed plan snapshots in the coordinator; no platform-task inference
selection: The single registered plan-stated tier, subject to coverage guards

standard.coverage: Application, tests, validation infrastructure and material contract changes

reclaim: BLOCKED: no protected host attestation/disruption approval provider
change_rule: Changed governing tooling, policy, tiers or parameters require a new actual approval before use. Changed plans need a new exact bound decision.
cutover: Separate actual scoped approval after two real successful bootstrap caller passes and required host proofs
retention: No automatic pruning. Permanent task IDs and decision history. 10000 event segments then fail closed for a scoped retention review.
backup: Explicit checkpoint after each accepted local task; isolated fenced restore only; no scheduler or production restore
